title: [AMD] sgl-kernel: enable gfx1151 (RDNA3.5 / Strix Halo) for single-GPU
body:
## Motivation

`sgl-kernel` currently `sys.exit(1)`s on any architecture other than gfx942/gfx950, so AMD **Strix Halo (gfx1151, RDNA3.5)** cannot build it. gfx1151 is also the first **wave32** target `sgl-kernel` would support (all prior AMD targets are wave64 CDNA), which surfaces two latent bugs:

title: [ROCm][MLA] Make num_kv_splits occupancy-aware for Triton MLA decode
body:
The Triton MLA decode split count was chosen from sequence length and CU count alone, ignoring batch and query heads. At high load every sequence still requests many KV splits, so the fp32 stage-1 partial-logits scratch (B, H, num_kv_splits, kv_lora_rank+1) inflates and the stage-2 reduce becomes bandwidth-bound.

Add an occupancy cap: the grouped stage-1 grid is
(batch, ceil(q_heads / BLOCK_H), splits) with num_kv_heads == 1, so the parallelism present before splitting is batch * head_blocks. Once that already fills the machine, cap the split count so extra splits stop inflating the scratch. The cap is applied as a min() on top of the existing split count, so it can never increase splits and cannot regress the low-batch / short-sequence regime; the worst-case workspace reservation stays valid.
